notes: Bounds measure the visible drawing, not transparent padding. A different standalone magnification never changes fitted dimensions.

New model renders use projected physical spans with a weak power law within each family. Unchanged selected raster drawings compress their prior visible dimension monotonically instead of claiming a new physical measurement. Both retain nonuniform sizes while bounding outliers. Named long thin tools receive an inspection exception.

Long drawing strips and the invitation banner use a 184px paper inspection class. Their before/after states and compound owner/overlays share one crop and transform. Fixed successors share a chapter crop, camera and magnification.

Flight scenes use a common 270px labeled composition: a large actual-camera whale detail, a whole-setup view, and service panels in the two applicable states. Their full canvas reserves space for the teaching panels.
The two service-side chapters use a full 248px square with a 220px main whale and a 90px actual-camera fitting detail. Reserve the complete labeled composition.
